problem_statement: An exhaustive project can either stop too early after local green checks or continue reviewing forever. The proposed protocol seeks an auditable, risk-proportionate stage boundary without converting process compliance into a claim of product or investment effectiveness.

fixed_subject: Fix one exact candidate commit and tree before a closure review begins.
Bind every review, reproduction, result, and disposition to that candidate.
A later modification creates a new candidate and cannot inherit an earlier acceptance verdict.
finding_closure_chain: reproduce the finding or preserve a bounded reason why reproduction is unavailable
identify and challenge the root cause rather than only the observed symptom
add a negative regression that fails on the vulnerable behavior
add or retain the adjacent positive path so fail-closed behavior cannot masquerade as correctness
re-run affected and neighboring checks on the fixed candidate
review_scope: Challenge both the candidate behavior and whether the declared review scope omitted relevant goals, components, failure classes, evidence, or user journeys.
Require candidate-postfix novelty probes rather than relying only on builder-authored canonical tests.
Keep machine execution provenance separate from semantic reviewer independence.

risk_proportionality.critical_and_major: Every known finding must complete the full closure chain or remain explicitly open and block the stage.
risk_proportionality.minor: May be deferred only with bounded impact, an owner or successor location, and a concrete future trigger.
risk_proportionality.unknowns: Must be listed with threat boundary, consequence, detection or monitoring path, and the event that reopens the stage.

candidate_freeze_eligibility: Every known Critical and Major finding is closed by fresh, reproducible evidence on the exact candidate.
Required evidence can be regenerated from recorded commands or runners and still matches its bound hashes and candidate identity.
Remaining unknowns and deferred items are explicit and each has a future trigger or successor boundary.
Independent review challenged both defects and omissions in scope.
Successive bounded review rounds show defensible convergence rather than merely repeating the same checklist.
non_equivalence: Stage closure is not project completion.
Governance green is not product usability.
Software assurance is not evidence that an investment strategy has edge.
Paper performance is not evidence of realizable live returns.

required_independent_challenges: Can a builder game convergence by renaming, splitting, suppressing, or downgrading findings?
Can repeated reviewers share the same blind spot and create false confidence while appearing independent?
Does the protocol add enough complexity that maintaining the process displaces building or testing the product?
Can a positive adjacent path still be too narrow to detect overblocking or unusable fail-closed behavior?
Can explicit unknowns become a dumping ground that permits premature freeze?
What observable evidence distinguishes genuine review convergence from reviewer fatigue or a fixed prompt reaching saturation?
Which later triggers reliably reopen a frozen stage when evidence, dependencies, AI methods, market rules, or user needs change?
How is financial effectiveness kept outside this process gate and evaluated by a separate prospective evidence program?

known_side_effects_and_failure_modes.required_challenge: Compare the additional artifacts and runtime cost with the marginal risk reduction; reject ceremony that has no decision consequence.

known_side_effects_and_failure_modes.risk: same-origin evidence or reviewers create an independence illusion
known_side_effects_and_failure_modes.required_challenge: Track construction participation, evidence provenance, novelty probes, and the explicit limit of platform-observable rather than organizational independence.

known_side_effects_and_failure_modes.risk: process green is misreported as product or financial validity
known_side_effects_and_failure_modes.required_challenge: Keep usability, longitudinal paper operation, calibration, benchmark comparison, and investment-effectiveness claims behind separate evidence gates.

known_side_effects_and_failure_modes.risk: endless review caused by an undefined demand for exhaustive certainty
known_side_effects_and_failure_modes.required_challenge: Define bounded review questions and candidate-specific stopping evidence without claiming that unknown defects are impossible.

known_side_effects_and_failure_modes.risk: premature convergence caused by fixed prompts, reviewer fatigue, or narrow fixtures
known_side_effects_and_failure_modes.required_challenge: Require scope attacks, mutation or counterexample novelty, and explicit disclosure when an additional reviewer produced no verdict.

promotion_rule: This proposal may enter a frozen governance contract only after an exact-candidate independent review addresses every required challenge, records any new Critical or Major finding, and identifies the smaller executable mechanism that should replace this narrative candidate.
